description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Generalized CLASS of the P302 pooltogether M-08 miss: a contract hard-codes the EIP-2612 7-arg `permit(owner,spender,value,deadline,v,r,s)` interface against a CONFIGURABLE/external asset (whatever asset the vault/yield source uses), with NO resilience (no try/catch, no Permit2 fallback, no DAI allowed-based / non-2612 handling). Non-standard-permit assets (DAI allowed/nonce-based, USDC-on-some-chains, no-permit tokens) make the permit path REVERT -> deposit/permit DoS. Three-signal AND gate: S1 EIP-2612 permit consumption + S2 the permitted token is a configurable/external asset (not the contract's own 2612 share token) + S3 missing resilience. Suppress: permit-primitive libraries; self/own-share-token permits; routers (caller-supplied token param); Permit2/try-catch resilient flows. Anchor: PrizeVault.depositWithPermit (PrizeVault.sol:524-546) IERC20Permit(address(_asset)).permit(...). Does NOT detect permit replay / front-run / asset-binding (see permit_asset_binding) / signature malleability.

fp_controls.three_signal_required: S1 EIP-2612 permit consumption AND S2 configurable/external asset AND S3 missing-resilience; a bare `.permit(` on a self/own share token never fires.
fp_controls.self_token_suppression: permit on address(this) / the contract's own ERC20Permit share token (2612 by construction) -> suppressed.
fp_controls.resilience_suppression: a try/catch around permit, OR a Permit2 (permitTransferFrom) / DAI-allowed (IDaiPermit/nonces/allowed) alternate path -> resilient -> suppressed.
fp_controls.router_suppression: router/aggregator/bridge by name OR a caller-supplied token/path parameter (asset-agnostic) -> suppressed.
fp_controls.library_suppression: the permit primitive itself (Permit2/SelfPermit/ERC20Permit/EIP2612) is not an integrator -> suppressed.
